title_o: The semantic red effect: Processing the word red undermines intellectual performance

replications.quote: Experiments 1 and 2 (Ns = 69 and 104) are direct replications of Lichtenfeld, Maier, Elliot, and Pekrun (2009). Both experiments failed to uncover a red color effect on verbal reasoning scores among high school students and undergraduates (Cohen’s d = 0.04 and -0.23).

effect.name: Processing the word red impairs intellectual performance
